Sources: the case admission review (Thai DDC melioidosis measures citing the DDC Guideline of Melioidosis 2021: IV ceftazidime, imipenem or meropenem at least 10-14 days then co-trimoxazole 12-20 weeks, co-amoxiclav second-line, boots; Darwin 2024 guideline: deep-seated collection 4 weeks IV; WHO SEARO IMAI District Clinician Manual 2021); opened the Laos recurrent melioidosis cohort (PMC4889735), which restates ceftazidime at least 10-14 days then co-trimoxazole 12-20 weeks and dropping doxycycline after MERTH 2014, plus web review summaries on diabetes as the main risk factor and 3 months as the minimum eradication length. Read all 13 banks, every option, all 3 alternatives in Thai and English against every question variant and every B/R/W entry path. Confirmed this round: step2.W.c[2] and step2.B.d[2] weigh now say the set does not show spread beyond the lung; step2.R.b[2], step2.W.b[2] and step2.W.d[2] weigh now carry the lab-notification line with no mud cue, so step2.R and step2.W replies name or hint no diagnosis the visitor has not chosen.
